name: languageVariable
help: Any Tag Manager variable holding a whole language pack - the JSON text of a published en.json or el.json in a Constant, a Custom JavaScript variable returning it, or a Lookup Table keyed on the page's language. Take the pack exactly as downloaded: the words under texts, the four categories keyed under consents, and optionally policyUrl. Anything it leaves out falls back to the built-in English.
